definitions: The rotating part of an electrical generator or motor.
The part of a magnetic circuit that is bridged by the main magnetic flux.
A framework or skeleton used to support a sculpture, especially one made of a pliable material like clay.
A protective covering or shell, especially of an animal or plant.
A piece of soft iron or steel connecting the poles of a magnet or electromagnet.
examples: The artist built an armature for the clay figure.
The armature was designed to maximize efficiency.
The armature of the mollusk provided protection.
